meta.title: DSH Piano
meta.description: A standard 88-key computer piano docked to the DeepSeek Harness, with 128 General MIDI instruments besides the piano. The model writes numbered notation with piano_score (both hands, octave dots, durations, dynamics), the plugin turns it into a timeline and plays it with the instrument you picked. It can also read standard MIDI files with piano_midi, or render the result offline to WAV with piano_export. The keyboard is a real 88 keys with black keys at their true proportions on the key seams; the piano tone is a per-key Yamaha sample set, and the other 127 instruments come from a General MIDI soundfont, using its own velocity layers, loops and tuning. The window docks above DSH and stays out of the taskbar. You can also play it yourself with the mouse or the A-J keys.
